How the two fit togetherStart free. Pay only if you want to build with me.The free webinar is complete on its own. You'll see the method, watch one idea go from page to first screen, and leave with a plan for your own weekend. You don't have to buy anything.The build-along is for people who'd rather not do the build alone. It's two hours on Zoom where you build your own MVP while I build one too, and you can ask questions as you go.If you only come to one, come to the free one first. It'll tell you whether the paid one is for you.01 · Sat 31 Oct · 16:00 GMTFree webinarLearn the weekend test.02 · Sat 14 Nov · 15:00 GMTWeekend MVP Build-AlongBuild yours, live.03 · Any weekendYour weekendPick an idea from the free library and keep going.

For you ifYou're a designer who wants to ship something real with AI, not just mock it up.You're a non-technical founder with a day job and an idea you keep putting off.You'd rather build one small thing than plan a big one.Not for you if×You want a coding course.×You're looking for a six-month program.

HostJohn IseghohiStaff product designer and founder of Weekend MVP.I build Weekend MVP around a full-time job, on evenings and Saturdays. I started it to close the gap between “I have an idea” and “here's a live URL”.
Free right nowDon't want to wait for a date?The idea library is free to browse. Every idea is sized for one weekend and comes with copy-paste prompts.Browse free ideas→Get the free Starter Kit

QuestionsAre the sessions really live?+–Yes. The free webinar streams on YouTube Live, and the link is public during the live hour, so anyone can watch. The build-along runs on Zoom so we can actually work together.Do I need to register for the free webinar?+–Not to watch live. Registering gets you reminders and the replay for 7 days.What's the difference between the free and paid sessions?+–In the free webinar you watch: I explain the weekend test and take one idea to its first screen. In the build-along you build: two hours, your own idea, with me building one too.Can I watch the free webinar later?+–Yes. Registrants get the replay for 7 days after the session. After that, an edited version goes up publicly on YouTube.Do I have to do the free one before the paid one?+–No, but it helps. The build-along moves fast and assumes you've seen the weekend test once. If you can't make 31 Oct live, the replay works.What time is that for me?+–Every time on this page is GMT. The free webinar is Sat 31 Oct at 16:00 GMT (12:00 New York, 09:00 Los Angeles). The build-along is Sat 14 Nov, 15:00–17:00 GMT (10:00–12:00 New York, 07:00–09:00 Los Angeles).Do I need to code?+–No. Every session uses AI tools and copy-paste prompts. Knowing some code helps, but you don't need it.Will there be more sessions?+–Yes. The next build-along is Sat 5 Dec 2026, 15:00 GMT, on Zoom. New free webinar dates will be listed here and sent to the newsletter once they're set.
